Getting here

How far is Bite More from here?

About 2 minutes up Roswell Rd from the theatre — 3150 Roswell Rd NW, Suite A1.

What time do you close?

Buckhead: 11am–12am Mon–Wed, 11am–1am Thursday, 11am–3am Friday and Saturday, 11am–1am Sunday. Duluth: 11am–9pm Mon–Wed, 11am–11pm Thu–Sun.

Is the food halal?

Yes — every protein at both kitchens is 100% halal.

Yes. Order online and collect when it's ready.
